decision: Reject adopting either wide-batch layout from these measurements. Proceed with a new candidate from the shared foundation that targets coordinate membership and compact source presence. No whole-application SIMD performance win is claimed from these layouts.
controls: Five isolated Cargo target directories, each with an explicit Canvas clean then fresh=false library/examples builds. Source, rlib, and executable hashes checked before/after the complete timing window; executable hashes checked before/after each process. Root coordinated the 18.19s quiet window after all agents reported idle. Three interleaved rounds, 1260 rows, exact image hashes and CPU structural stats match.
invalid_capture: paired-timing-invalid-shared-alias.tar.gz is excluded from every layout or performance conclusion. Shared target unqualified example aliases were overwritten by other worktrees; identity audit showed two labels had identical executable hashes. Rebuilt all controls in isolated target dirs, retaining the failed capture and repair provenance.
valid_findings: SoA improves only uncompressed full-overlap controls to about0.565x baseline time; AoS about0.75x. Ordinary proof-enabled flat/opaque/labels remain roughly0.98-1.00x. Both layouts regress transformed primitives around1.08x and whole images materially: AoS roughly1.14-1.40x and SoA1.14-1.46x. No-proof labels roughly1.14-1.15x. See exact raw medians/ratios; small differences near1 are not asserted wins.
limitations: Three process rounds and eight warmed image frames/process; these are host CPU canvas controls, not independent application/user interaction measurements.
Root requests a separate original-versus-foundation normal/Fallback comparison before promoting the foundation; that result is still pending.
No AVX512/NEON execution is claimed. All supported host kernel backends pass exact working-bit/full-scene tests; SoA Apple/MSVC normal/Fallback type checks pass.
Image helpers and exact sample reduction are included in complete timing costs; microkernel arithmetic is not used to excuse whole-image regressions.
